species.name: Penyu sisik
species.summary: Penyu sisik (Eretmochelys imbricata) adalah jenis penyu terancam punah yang tergolong dalam familia Cheloniidae. Penyu ini adalah satu-satunya spesies dalam genusnya. Spesies ini memiliki persebaran di seluruh dunia, dengan dua subspesies terdapat di Atlantik dan Pasifik. E.

species.name: Monyet yaki
species.summary: Yaki atau Monyet wolai atau Monyet hitam Sulawesi (Macaca nigra) adalah satwa endemik Indonesia yang hanya terdapat Pulau Sulawesi bagian utara dan beberapa pulau di sekitarnya. Yaki merupakan jenis monyet makaka terbesar yang ada di Pulau Sulawesi.

species.name: Gajahan timur
species.summary: The Far Eastern curlew (Numenius madagascariensis) is a large shorebird most similar in appearance to the long-billed curlew, but slightly larger. It is mostly brown in color, differentiated from other curlews by its plain, unpatterned brown underwing.

Acropora hyacinthus is a species of acroporid coral found from the Indian Ocean, the Indo-Pacific waters, southeast Asia, Japan, the East China Sea and the western Pacific Ocean. It lives on shallow reefs on upper reef slopes, and is found from depths of 1–25 m.

Acropora muricata, yang umum dikenal sebagai karang tanduk rusa, adalah spesies karang dari famili Acroporidae yang ditemukan di Teluk Aden, Laut Merah, Samudra Hindia, Teluk Persia, Australia, Indo-Pasifik tengah, Jepang, Asia Tenggara, Laut Tiongkok Timur, serta Samudra Pasifik bagian tengah dan barat.

Acropora cerealis is a species of acroporid coral found throughout the Indian and Pacific oceans, from the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden to the Hawaiian Islands and the Johnston Atoll. It can be found on upper reef slopes in shallow tropical reefs, from depths of 3–20 m.

The branch coral (Acropora florida) is a species of acroporid coral found in the southwest and northern Indian Ocean, the central Indo-Pacific, Australia, Southeast Asia, Japan and the East China Sea, Cook Islands and the oceanic west Pacific Ocean.

Isopora palifera is a species of stony coral in the family Acroporidae. It is a reef building coral living in shallow water and adopts different forms depending on the water conditions where it is situated. It is found in the Western Indo-Pacific Ocean as far east as Australia.

species.name: Kedidi Besar
species.summary: Burung kedidi besar adalah salah satu keluarga Scolopacidae. Dan merupakan salah satu jenis yang terbesar dari jenis Calidris lainnya.

Acropora valida is a species of acroporid coral found in the Red Sea, the Gulf of Aden, the southwestern, northwestern and northern Indian Ocean, the Persian Gulf, the central Indo-Pacific, Australia, southeast Asia, Japan, the East China Sea, the oceanic western, central and far eastern Pacific Ocean, the northwestern…
Acropora loripes is a species of branching colonial stony coral. It is common on reefs, upper reef slopes and reef flats in the tropical Indo-Pacific. Its type locality is the Great Barrier Reef.
Acropora latistella is a species of Acropora polyp coral found in tropical reefs in the Indo-Pacific Ocean from depths ranging from 3 – 20 meters.
Acropora nasuta is a species of branching stony coral in the family Acroporidae. It is native to the western and central Indo-Pacific where it is found in shallow reef habitats.

Acropora humilis, also known as Finger coral, is a species of acroporid coral found in the Gulf of Aden, the Red Sea, the northern and southwestern Indian Ocean, Australia, the central Indo-Pacific, Japan, southeast Asia, the East China Sea, the central and western Pacific Ocean, the Johnston Atoll and the northwestern…
Acropora austera is a species of Acropora coral found in the Indo-Pacific. A. austera are fast-growing that are dispersed in ocean currents.

Acropora tenuis is a species of acroporid coral found in the Red Sea, the Gulf of Aden, the southwest, northwest and northern Indian Ocean, the Persian Gulf, the central Indo-Pacific, Australia, Southeast Asia, Japan, the East China Sea and the oceanic west and central Pacific Ocean.

Acropora secale is a species of branching staghorn stony coral. It is found in shallow parts of the Indo-Pacific Ocean and the type locality is Sri Lanka. The oldest fossils found date back to the Pleistocene.

Acropora clathrata, commonly known as lattice table coral is a species of stony corals belonging to the family Acroporidae. They are a zooxanthellate coral, which are generally found in fringing reefs, sheltered reefs and back reef habitats, between the depths of 5–40 m (16–131 ft).

Acropora gemmifera is a species of acroporid coral found in the Gulf of Aden, the Red Sea, the central Indo-Pacific, the southwest and northern Indian Ocean, southeastern Asia, Australia, the East China Sea, Japan, the oceanic central and western Pacific Ocean, and northwestern Hawaiʻi.
Acropora millepora is a species of branching stony coral native to the western Indo-Pacific where it is found in shallow water from the east coast of Africa to the coasts of Japan and Australia.

Acropora subglabra is a species of acroporid coral found in the northern Indian Ocean, the central Indo-Pacific, Australia, Southeast Asia, Japan, the East China Sea and the oceanic west Pacific Ocean.

Acropora acuminata is a species of acroporid coral found in Australia, the Red Sea, the central Indo-Pacific, Japan, the northern Indian Ocean, the East China Sea, southeast Asia, and the western Pacific Ocean.

Acropora microphthalma is a species of acroporid coral found in the Red Sea, the Gulf of Aden, the southwest and northern Indian Ocean, the central Indo-Pacific, Australia, Southeast Asia, Japan, the East China Sea and the oceanic west and central Pacific Ocean. It is also found in the Line Islands.

Acropora samoensis is a species of acroporid coral found in the Red Sea, the Gulf of Aden, the southwest and northern Indian Ocean, the central Indo-Pacific, Australia, Southeast Asia, Japan, the East China Sea and the oceanic west and central Pacific Ocean.

Acropora donei is a species of acroporid coral that was first described by J. Veron and Carden Wallace in 1984. Found in fringing reefs and the upper slopes of shallow reefs, it occurs at depths of 5 to 20 m (16 to 66 ft).

Acropora horrida is a species of acroporid coral that was first described by James Dwight Dana in 1846. Found in tropical, shallow reefs in marine environments, it occurs near fringing reefs around turbid water, at depths of 5 to 20 m (16 to 66 ft).

Acropora indonesia is a species of acroporid coral that was first described by Dr Carden Wallace in 1997. Found in marine, tropical, shallow reefs in sheltered flat locations or gentle slopes, it occurs at depths of 10 to 20 m (33 to 66 ft).

Acropora digitifera is a species of acroporid coral found in the Gulf of Aden, the Red Sea, the southwest and northern Indian Ocean, Australia, southeast Asia, the central Indo-Pacific, Japan, the west Pacific Ocean and the East China Sea.

Acropora hoeksemai is a species of acroporid coral that was first described by Dr. Carden Wallace in 1997. Found in shallow reefs in a marine environment, it is found at depths of 8 to 20 m (26 to 66 ft). It is listed as a vulnerable species on the IUCN Red List, and has a decreasing population.

Acropora paniculata is a species of acroporid coral that was first described by Addison Emery Verrill in 1902. Found in marine, tropical, shallow reefs on the upper slopes, it occurs at depths of between 10 and 35 m (33 and 115 ft).

Acropora echinata is a species of acroporid coral that was first described by Dana in 1846. Found in shallow, tropical, sheltered reefs in marine environments, it is found at depths of 8 to 25 m (26 to 82 ft) in clear water. The species is listed as vulnerable on the IUCN Red List, and has a decreasing population.

Acropora microclados is a species of acroporid coral that was first described by Christian Gottfried Ehrenberg in 1834. Found in marine, tropical shallow reefs on the upper slopes, it is found at depths of 5 to 20 m (16 to 66 ft).

species.name: Kakatua putih
species.summary: Kakatua putih atau kakatua payung (Cacatua alba) adalah burung berukuran sedang, dengan panjang sekitar 46 cm, dari genus Cacatua. Burung ini hampir semua bulunya berwarna putih. Di kepalanya terdapat jambul besar berwarna putih yang dapat ditegakkan. Bulu-bulu terbang dan ekornya berwarna kuning.

Acropora pulchra is a species of colonial staghorn coral in the family Acroporidae. It is found on the back fringes of reefs in shallow water in the western Indo-Pacific Ocean. The oldest fossils of this species date back to the Pleistocene.
Acropora aspera is a species of staghorn coral in the family Acroporidae. It is found on reef flats and in lagoons in very shallow water in the western Indo-Pacific Ocean.

Acropora abrolhosensis is a species of acroporid coral that was first described by John Veron in 1985. Found in sheltered lagoons and shallow reefs, it is listed as a vulnerable species on the IUCN Red List.

Lithophyllon repanda is a species of mushroom or disc coral in the family Fungiidae.This species is able to move to another location on occasion. The International Union for the Conservation of Nature (IUCN) rated it as a least-concern species and it was originally described by Dana in 1846.

Acropora awi is a species of acroporid coral that was first described by Wallace and Wolstenholme in 1998. Found in fringing reefs, the slopes of shallow reefs, and sandy slopes, it occurs in a marine environment.

Acropora polystoma is a species of acroporid coral that was first described by G. Brook in 1891. Found in marine, tropical, reefs on upper slopes where waves are strong, it occurs at depths between 3 and 10 m (9.8 and 32.8 ft).

Acropora vaughani is a species of acroporid coral found in the northern Indian Ocean, the central Indo-Pacific, Australia, southeast Asia, Japan, the East China Sea and the oceanic western and central Pacific Ocean. It is also found in Madagascar.

Danafungia scruposa is a species of coral that is the first to have been observed to eat jellyfish. It was described by Klunzinger in 1879 and has a diameter of around 25 centimetres (10 in). It is rated as a least-concern species.

The reticulate whipray or honeycomb stingray (Himantura uarnak) is a species of stingray in the family Dasyatidae. It inhabits coastal and brackish waters across the Indo-Pacific region from South Africa to Taiwan to Australia, favoring sandy habitats.

species.name: Kura-kura Ambon
species.summary: The Amboina box turtle (Cuora amboinensis), or southeast Asian box turtle is a species of Asian box turtle.

Favites valenciennesi is a species of stony coral in the family Merulinidae. It is native to the Indo-Pacific region and its range extends from Madagascar through the Indian Ocean to the Western and Central Pacific Ocean.

Acropora plumosa is a species of acroporid coral that was first described by Dr. C. C. Wallace and J. Wolstenholme in 1998. Found in marine, tropical, reefs on slopes sheltered from wave action, and on reef walls. It occurs at depths between 10 and 30 m (33 and 98 ft).

species.name: Kakatua maluku
species.summary: Kakatua maluku atau dalam nama ilmiahnya Cacatua moluccensis adalah burung berukuran sedang, dengan panjang sekitar 52 cm, dari genus Cacatua. Burung ini mempunyai bulu putih bercampur warna merah-jambu. Di kepalanya terdapat jambul besar berwarna merah-jambu yang dapat ditegakkan.
Mobula kuhlii, the shortfin devil ray, is a species of eagle ray in the genus Mobula. It is endemic to the Indian Ocean and central-west Pacific Ocean.

Acropora kirstyae is a species of acroporid coral that was first described by Jen Veron and C. C. Wallace in 1984. Found in marine, tropical, shallow reefs in sheltered areas usually at depths of 10 to 25 m (33 to 82 ft), and also occurs in sheltered lagoons.

The spectacled flying fox (Pteropus conspicillatus), also known as the spectacled fruit bat, is a megabat that lives in Australia's north-eastern regions of Queensland. It is also found in New Guinea and on the offshore islands including Woodlark Island, Alcester Island, Kiriwina, and Halmahera.

species.name: Biawak kalimantan
species.summary: Biawak tak bertelinga adalah salah satu hewan endemik Kalimantan, Indonesia. Biawak tak bertelinga termasuk dalam ordo ''Squamata'' dan termasuk suku Varanoidea. Hewan ini memiliki nama ilmiah Lanthanotus borneensis. Biawak tak bertelinga pertama kali ditemukan pada tanggal 30 Mei 2008.

species.name: Kuskus gebe
species.summary: Kuskus Gebe (Phalanger alexandrae) adalah jenis kuskus dari spesies marsupialia dalam keluarga Phalangeridae. Hewan ini adalah endemik dari Pulau Gebe di Maluku Utara, Indonesia. Tempat tinggal Kuskus Gebe berada di ketinggian 300 meter dari permukaan laut.
Tropidonophis punctiventris the Halmahera keelback, is a species of colubrid snake. It is found in Indonesia.

species.name: Cerek Besar
species.summary: Cerek besar (bahasa Latin = Pluvialis squatarola) adalah spesies burung dari famili Charadriidae, dari genus Pluvialis. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan invertebrata yang memiliki habitat di gosong lumpur dan pasir di daerah pasang surut.

species.name: Rusa timor
species.summary: Rusa Jawa atau sambar Sunda (Rusa timorensis) adalah jenis rusa yang endemik di wilayah pulau Jawa, Bali dan Timor (termasuk Timor Leste) di Indonesia.

species.name: Kedidi Ekor-Tajam
species.summary: The sharp-tailed sandpiper (Calidris acuminata) (but see below) is a small wader.

Hippocampus kuda, also known as the estuary seahorse, yellow seahorse or spotted seahorse is a seahorse of the family Syngnathidae native to the Indo-Pacific. The common name sea pony has been used for this species under its synonym Hippocampus fuscus.

species.name: Walik benjol
species.summary: The carunculated fruit dove (Ptilinopus granulifrons) is a species of bird in the family Columbidae. It is endemic to Obira.

species.name: Gosong maluku
species.summary: Gosong maluku (Eulipoa wallacei) adalah sejenis burung gosong berukuran kecil, dengan panjang sekitar 31 cm, dan merupakan satu-satunya spesies di dalam genus tunggal Eulipoa.

species.name: Dara laut aleutian
species.summary: The Aleutian tern (Onychoprion aleuticus, formerly Sterna aleutica) is a seabird in the family Laridae. The genus name is from Ancient Greek onux, "claw", and "prion", nail. The specific aleuticus refers to the Aleutian Islands.

Acropora granulosa is a species of acroporid coral found in the northern and southwest Indian Ocean, the Red Sea, Australia, the East China Sea, Japan, the oceanic central and western Pacific Ocean, and the central Indo-Pacific.

species.name: Berkik-gunung maluku
species.summary: The Moluccan woodcock (Scolopax rochussenii), also known as Obi woodcock, is a medium-sized, approximately 40 cm long, forest wader with long and dark bill, orange buff below and black barred upperparts. The plumage is marked with large buff spots.

species.name: Kasturi ternate
species.summary: The chattering lory (Lorius garrulus) is a forest-dwelling parrot endemic to North Maluku, Indonesia. It is considered vulnerable, the main threat being from trapping for the cage-bird trade.

species.name: Gosong sula
species.summary: Gosong sula atau kailong (Megapodius bernsteinii), adalah spesies burung dari famili Megapodiidae. Burung ini hanya dapat ditemukan di Indonesia, dengan habitat pada hutan subtropikal atau hutan tropis, hutan dataran rendah subtropis atau tropis, hutan mangrove subtropis atau tropis, dan dataran dengan tumbuhan perdu b…

Seriatopora hystrix is a species of colonial stony coral in the family Pocilloporidae. It forms a bushy clump and is commonly known as thin birdsnest coral. It grows in shallow water on fore-reef slopes or in sheltered lagoons, the type locality being the Red Sea.

species.name: Linne, 1758 nautilus berongga
species.summary: Nautilus berongga (Nautilus pompilius) atau nautilus bilik (semuanya terjemahan dari chambered nautilus) adalah spesies nautilus yang paling diketahui. Cangkangnya, bila dipotong, akan memperlihatkan gewang berkilau dan spiral logaritmik yang hampir sempurna, meski bukan spiral emas.

species.name: Ketam kenari
species.summary: Ketam kenari atau ketam kelapa (Birgus latro) merupakan artropoda darat terbesar di dunia. Meskipun disebut ketam atau kepiting, hewan ini bukanlah kepiting. Ketam ini merupakan jenis umang-umang yang sangat maju dalam hal evolusi.

The invisible rail, Wallace's rail, or drummer rail (Habroptila wallacii) is a large flightless rail that is endemic to the island of Halmahera in North Maluku, Indonesia, where it inhabits impenetrable sago swamps adjacent to forests.

Acropora jacquelineae is a species of acroporid coral found in the eastern Indian Ocean and the central and western Pacific Ocean. It can be found offshore of Indonesia, Malaysia, Papua New Guinea, the Samoan Islands, and the Solomon Islands.

species.name: Ceret taliabu
species.summary: The Taliabu bush warbler (Locustella portenta) is a species of Old World warbler in the family Locustellidae. It is endemic to the island regency of Taliabu in Indonesia.

species.name: Duyung
species.habitat: Shallow, warm coastal and inshore waters, especially seagrass beds in bays, mangrove channels, and the leeward sides of large islands. They avoid deep open ocean, preferring depths generally under 10 meters to access seagrass pastures.
species.summary: Duyung atau dugong (Dugong dugon) adalah sejenis mamalia laut yang merupakan salah satu anggota Sirenia atau sapi laut yang masih bertahan hidup selain manatee dan mampu mencapai usia 22 sampai 25 tahun. Duyung bukanlah ikan karena menyusui anaknya dan masih merupakan kerabat evolusi dari gajah.

Weber's sailfin lizard (Hydrosaurus weberi), is an agamid lizard found in Indonesia. Specifically, it is endemic to Halmahera and Ternate Islands of Maluku. It has a life-span of between 10–15 years. H. weberi is the smallest of the three recognized species of Hydrosaurus, attaining an avg.

species.name: Kuskus matabiru
species.summary: Kuskus Mata Biru (Phalanger matabiru) adalah spesies dari marsupial dalam keluarga Phalangeridae. Hewan ini endemik dari dua pulau Tidore dan Ternate, dari Kepulauan Halmahera di Maluku Utara, Indonesia.

Ecsenius randalli is a species of combtooth blenny in the genus Ecsenius. It is found the western central Pacific ocean, around Indonesia. It can reach a maximum length of 2 centimetres. Blennies in this species feed primarily off of plants, including benthic algae and weeds.

The milk shark (Rhizoprionodon acutus) is a species of requiem shark, and part of the family Carcharhinidae, whose common name comes from an Indian belief that consumption of its meat promotes lactation.
Rabdion forsteni is a species of snake in the family Colubridae.
The Moluccan bow-fingered gecko (Cyrtodactylus deveti) is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to the Moluccas in Indonesia.

Megachile pluto atau Chalicodoma pluto, kadang juga disebut Lebah raksasa Wallace atau nama setempat o ofungu ma koana ("raja lebah") adalah sebuah spesies lebah berukuran besar dari Indonesia yang termasuk dalam famili Megachilidae (lebah resin).

Varanus yuwonoi, also known as the black-backed mangrove monitor or tricolor monitor, is a species of monitor lizard in the family Varanidae. It belongs to the V. doreanus species complex. It is endemic to the island of Halmahera, in the Maluku Islands, Indonesia.

species.name: Pergam Hijau
species.summary: Pergam hijau adalah spesies burung yang terdapat di sebagian besar wilayah Indonesia, bulu bagian atas punggung dan ekor bagian bawah berwarna cokelat tua.

species.name: Cikrak pulau
species.summary: The island leaf warbler (Phylloscopus poliocephalus) is a species of Old World warbler in the family Phylloscopidae. It is found in an area ranging from the Moluccas to the Solomon Islands. It has 16 subspecies.

species.name: Kedidi Leher-Merah
species.summary: Kedidi leher-merah (bahasa Latin = Calidris ruficollis) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Scolopacidae, dari genus Calidris. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan Moluska, krustasea yang memiliki habitat di gosong lumpur, muara pasang surut, tambak, mangrove.

species.name: Trinil Pembalik-Batu
species.summary: The ruddy turnstone (Arenaria interpres) is a small wading bird, one of two species of turnstone in the genus Arenaria. The scientific name is from Latin. The genus name arenaria derives from arenarius, "inhabiting sand, from arena, "sand".

species.name: Rajawali kuskus
species.summary: Rajawali kuskus (Aquila gurneyi) adalah burung pemangsa dari famili Accipitridae yang menghuni Papua. Spesies ini merupakan satwa liar dilindungi di Indonesia.

species.name: Wili-wili besar
species.summary: Wili-wili besar (Esacus magnirostris) adalah spesies burung dalam famili Burhinidae. Burung ini tersebar di Kepulauan Andaman dan Semenanjung Malaysia hingga ke Filipina, Indonesia dan Papua, juga di Australia dan Kepulauan Pasifik barat daya.

species.name: Penggunting-laut belang
species.summary: The streaked shearwater (Calonectris leucomelas) is a species of seabird. The adult bird averages 48 cm (19 in) in length, with a 122 cm (48 in) wingspan.

species.name: Elang perut-karat
species.summary: Elang perut-karat (Lophotriorchis kienerii) adalah satu jenis burung pemangsa dari famili Accipitridae, subfamili Accipitrinae dan genus Lophotriorchis. Elang ini dapat dijumpai di beberapa daerah berhutan tropis dari semenajung Asia Selatan atau Asia Tenggara.

species.name: Biru-Laut Ekor-Blorok
species.summary: The bar-tailed godwit (Limosa lapponica) is a large wader in the family Scolopacidae. The genus name Limosa is from Latin and means "muddy", from limus, "mud". The specific lapponica refers to Lapland. The English term "godwit" was first recorded in about 1416–7 and is believed to imitate the bird's call.

species.name: Pergam Katanjar
species.summary: Pergam katanjar (Ducula rosacea) adalah spesies burung dalam famili Columbidae. Burung ini tersebar di pulau-pulau kecil di Laut Jawa, Sulawesi Selatan, Maluku, dan Nusa Tenggara.

species.name: Takur warna-warni
species.summary: The red-throated barbet (Psilopogon mystacophanos) is a species of bird in the family Megalaimidae. It is found in Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, Singapore, and Thailand. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forest and subtropical or tropical swamps. It is threatened by habitat loss.

species.name: Pelanduk ekor-pendek
species.summary: The short-tailed babbler (Pellorneum malaccense) is a species of bird in the family Pellorneidae.It is found in Peninsular Malaysia, Singapore, and Thailand as well as the islands of Sumatra and Borneo (and some of the smaller surrounding islands).

species.name: Tepus Tunggir-Merah
species.summary: Tepus tunggir-merah adalah burung yang mempunyai paruh, berdarah panas, dan bereproduksi dengan cara bertelur.

species.name: Asi Besar
species.summary: The rufous-crowned babbler (Malacopteron magnum) is a species of bird in the Pellorneidae family. It is found in Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, the Philippines, and Thailand. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests. It is threatened by habitat loss.

species.name: Biru-Laut Ekor-Hitam
species.summary: The black-tailed godwit (Limosa limosa) is a large, long-legged, long-billed shorebird first described by Carl Linnaeus in 1758. It is a member of the Limosa genus, the godwits.

The azure dollarbird (Eurystomus azureus) also known as the azure roller, purple dollarbird or purple roller, is a species of bird in the Coraciidae family. It is endemic to the Maluku Islands in Indonesia. Formerly, some authorities considered the azure dollarbird to be a subspecies of the oriental dollarbird.

species.name: Elang-Ikan Kecil
species.summary: The lesser fish eagle (Icthyophaga humilis) is a species of Icthyophaga found in the Indian subcontinent, primarily in the foothills of the Himalayas, and south-east Asia.

species.name: Philentoma Kerudung
species.summary: The maroon-breasted philentoma (Philentoma velata) is a bird species. Long placed in the flycatcher family (Muscicapidae) when these were used as a "wastebin taxon", they are now tentatively assigned to the Tephrodornithidae pending detailed study.

species.name: Junai emas
species.summary: Junai emas atau dalam nama ilmiahnya Caloenas nicobarica adalah sejenis merpati berukuran sedang, dengan panjang sekitar 34cm, dari salah satu genus burung merpati Caloenas.

species.name: Kakatua raja
species.summary: Kakatua raja atau dalam nama ilmiahnya Probosciger aterrimus adalah sejenis burung Kakatua berwarna hitam dan berukuran besar, dengan panjang sekitar 60 cm. Burung ini memiliki kulit pipi berwarna merah dan paruh besar berwarna kehitaman. Di kepalanya terdapat jambul besar yang dapat ditegakkan.

species.name: Sikatan-rimba banggai
species.summary: The Banggai jungle flycatcher (Cyornis pelingensis) is a species of passerine bird in the Old World flycatcher family Muscicapidae. It is endemic to Peleng in Indonesia where its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests.

species.name: Raja-perling sula
species.summary: The helmeted myna (Basilornis galeatus) is a species of starling in the family Sturnidae. It is endemic to Indonesia.

The dusky friarbird (Philemon fuscicapillus) is a species of friarbird in the honeyeater family Meliphagidae. It is a dark brown bird with pale undersides. The area around the eye is bare and pink. It is around 30 cm long.
Bryaninops natans, known commonly as the redeye goby, is a species of marine fish in the family Gobiidae.

The Morotai white-eye (Zosterops dehaani) is a species of bird in the family Zosteropidae. It is endemic to Morotai in the northern Moluccas. It was separated from the cream-throated white-eye based on distinct plumage, exceptional dawn song, and submontane/montane ecology...

species.name: Anis Menden
species.summary: Anis peleng (Geokichla mendeni) , juga dikenal sebagai anis merah-hitam, adalah spesies burung dalam famili Turdidae. Hewan ini endemik di hutan Pulau Taliabu dan Peleng, Indonesia, yang terancam oleh hilangnya habitat . Secara tradisional, ia dianggap sebagai subspesies dari anis punggung merah.

species.name: Celepuk sula
species.summary: The Sula scops owl (Otus sulaensis), is a small owl in the scops-owl genus Otus found on the Sula Islands of Indonesia. Taxonomically, some groups consider it to be a distinct species (Otus sulensis), others a subspecies of the Sulawesi scops owl, and yet others a subspecies of the Moluccan scops owl.

species.name: Blibong sula
species.summary: The bare-eyed myna (Streptocitta albertinae) is a large, long-tailed species of starling in the family Sturnidae. Its common name is a reference to the large patch of dark bare skin around the eyes. Due to its superficial resemblance to a magpie, it has been referred to as the Sula magpie in the past.

The Sula dwarf kingfisher (Ceyx wallacii), is a species of bird in the family Alcedinidae that is endemic to the Sula Islands in Indonesia. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests. It was formerly considered to be a subspecies of the variable dwarf kingfisher.
Wallace's Golden Birdwing (Ornithoptera croesus) adalah sebuah spesies kupu-kupu sayap burung yang ditemukan di utara Maluku di Indonesia.
The black pipe snake (Cylindrophis melanotus) is a species of snake in the family Cylindrophiidae endemic to Indonesia.

species.name: Serak taliabu
species.summary: Serak taliabu (Tyto nigrobrunnea) adalah spesies burung hantu dalam famili Tytonidae. Burung ini endemik di Pulau Taliabu, Kepulauan Sula.

species.name: Perkici kuning-hijau
species.summary: Perkici kuning-hijau (Trichoglossus flavoviridis) adalah spesies burung perkici dalam famili Psittaculidae.

Hemiscyllium halmahera, or the Halmahera epaulette shark, is a species of bamboo shark from Indonesia. This species is described from two specimens collected near Ternate island in 2013, off the coast of larger Halmahera island.

The small flying fox, island flying fox or variable flying fox (Pteropus hypomelanus) is a species of flying fox in the family Pteropodidae. It is found in Australia, Cambodia, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Maldives, Myanmar, Papua New Guinea, the Philippines, the Solomon Islands, Thailand, and Vietnam.
The short-finned eel (Anguilla australis), also known as the shortfin eel, is one of the 15 species of eel in the family Anguillidae.

The cowtail stingray, Pastinachus sephen, is a species of stingray in the family Dasyatidae, widespread in the Indo-Pacific region and occasionally entering freshwater habitats. Other common names include banana-tail ray, drab stingray, fantail ray, feathertail stingray, and frill tailed sting ray.

species.name: Walik sula
species.summary: The Sula fruit dove (Ptilinopus mangoliensis) is a species of bird in the family Columbidae. It is endemic to the Sula Islands. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests. It is threatened by habitat loss.
The Halmahera blossom bat (Syconycteris carolinae) is a species of megabat in the family Pteropodidae.

species.name: Burung-Gereja Erasia
species.summary: Burung-gereja erasia (Passer montanus) atau dalam bahasa Inggris dikenal juga sebagai Eurasian Tree Sparrow adalah spesies burung pengicau dalam famili Passeridae.

species.name: Tekukur
species.summary: Tekukur Biasa (bahasa Inggris: spotted dove; Spilopelia chinensis) adalah sejenis burung merpati kecil yang mempunyai paruh, berekor agak panjang, berdarah panas, dan bereproduksi dengan cara bertelur.

species.name: Cekakak Sungai
species.summary: Cekakak sungai (bahasa Latin = Todirhamphus chloris) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Alcedinidae, dari genus Todirhamphus.

species.name: Merbah cerukcuk
species.summary: Merbah cerukcuk:286 (Pycnonotus goiavier) adalah sejenis burung pengicau dari suku Pycnonotidae. Orang Sunda menyebutnya cica, cucak, cerukcuk atau jogjog, orang Jawa menyebut terucuk atau cerocokan, mengikuti bunyi suaranya yang khas. Dalam bahasa Inggris disebut Yellow-vented Bulbul.

species.name: Walet Sapi
species.summary: Walet sapi (Collocalia esculenta) adalah sejenis burung anggota suku Apodidae. Burung ini menyebar luas di Australia, Brunei, Burma, Christmas Island, Filipina, India, Indonesia, Kaledonia Baru, Malaysia, Papua Nugini, Singapura, Kepulauan Solomon, Thailand, dan Vanuatu.

species.name: Blekok
species.summary: Blekok sawah (Ardeola speciosa) adalah spesies burung dari famili Ardeidae. Makanan utamanya adalah serangga, ikan, dan kepiting. Burung ini menyebar luas di Asia Tenggara. Panjang tubuh sekitar 46 cm. Paruh berwarna kuning dan hitam pada ujungnya. Pada masa tidak berbiak warna punggung lebih kecokelatan.

species.name: Elang bondol
species.summary: Elang bondol (Haliastur indus) adalah spesies burung pemangsa dari famili Accipitridae.

species.name: Perkutut
species.summary: Perkutut jawa (Geopelia striata) adalah spesies burung dalam suku Columbidae, dari genus Geopelia. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan biji-bijian saja, akan tetapi tidak tertutup kemungkinan jika burung ini juga memakan serangga di habitat aslinya.

species.name: Kuntul Kecil
species.summary: Kuntul kecil (Egretta garzetta) adalah sejenis burung dari suku Ardeidae (kerabat cangak). Disebut Little Egret dalam bahasa Inggris, burung ini mempunyai ‘kembarannya’ di Dunia Baru, yakni kuntul salju atau Snowy Egret (Egretta thula) dari Karibia.

species.name: Trinil Pantai
species.summary: Trinil pantai (bahasa Latin = Actitis hypoleucos) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Scolopacidae, dari genus Actitis. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan krustasea, serangga, invertebrata lain yang memiliki habitat di habitat luas.

Burung ini adalah termasuk ordo Cuculiformes dan genus Cacomantis. Burung ini bersuara mendayu-dayu, tiit tu wiiit,tiit tu wiit tiiit tu wiit panjang dengan nada yang makin rendah kadang makin tinggi.

species.name: Burung-Madu Kelapa
species.summary: Burung-madu kelapa (Anthreptes malacensis) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Nectariniidae, dari genus Anthreptes. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan nektar Loranthus, Musa, Hibiscus, serangga, ulat, laba-laba, buah lembu dan memiliki habitat di pekarangan terbuka, kebun kelapa, semak pantai, hutan mangrove.

species.name: Kareo Padi
species.summary: Kareo Padi atau Ruak-ruak (Amaurornis phoenicurus) kabuburak/burak-burak bahasa Banjar adalah spesies burung yang masuk dalam famili Rallidae. Burung ini tersebar di India, China selatan, Asia Tenggara, Filipina, Kalimantan,Sulawesi, Sunda Besar dan Nusa Tenggara.

species.name: Nuri pipi-merah
species.summary: Nuri pipi-merah (Geoffroyus geoffroyi) adalah spesies burung nuri dalam famili Psittaculidae. Burung ini tersebar di Papua, Nusa Tenggara, Maluku, dan Australia bagian utara.

species.name: Kepudang Kuduk-Hitam
species.summary: Kepudang kuduk-hitam (Oriolus chinensis) atau kepudang kapas adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Oriolidae, dari genus Oriolus. Burung ini memiliki habitat di hutan terbuka, hutan sekunder, hutan mangrove, perkebunan, pedesaan, tersebar sampai ketinggian 1.600 mdpl.

species.name: Julang irian
species.summary: Julang Papua atau Rangkong Papua (Rhyticeros plicatus) adalah spesies rangkong yang terdapat di kawasan melanesia.

species.name: Cangak Merah
species.summary: Cangak Merah adalah spesies burung Kuntul yang berukuran besar, yakni 78–97 cm. Warna abu-abu coklat berangan. Iris kuning, paruh coklat, kaki coklat kemerahan. Bulu lainnya pada burung ini berwarna coklat kemerahan. Terdapat setrip hitam menurun sepanjang leher yang merah-karat khas.

species.name: Punai Gading
species.summary: Punai gading adalah spesies burung yang mempunyai paruh, berdarah panas, dan membiak dengan cara bertelur.

The uniform swiftlet, (Aerodramus vanikorensis), also known as the Vanikoro or lowland swiftlet, is a gregarious, medium-sized swiftlet with a shallowly forked tail. The colouring is dark grey-brown, darker on the upperparts with somewhat paler underparts, especially on chin and throat.

species.name: Layang-Layang Api
species.summary: Layang-layang asia (bahasa Latin: Hirundo rustica) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Hirundinidae, dari genus Hirundo, yang mempunyai paruh, berdarah panas, dan membiak dengan cara bertelur. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan serangga keci yang memiliki habitat di hutan, kebun, tegalan, sawah, pedesaan, kota.

species.name: Kipasan Kebun
species.summary: The willie (or willy) wagtail (Rhipidura leucophrys) is a passerine bird native to Australia, New Guinea, the Solomon Islands, the Bismarck Archipelago, and Eastern Indonesia. It is a common and familiar bird throughout much of its range, living in most habitats apart from thick forest.

species.name: Cangak besar
species.summary: The great egret (Ardea alba), also known as the common egret, large egret or (in the Old World) great white egret or great white heron is a large, widely distributed egret, with four subspecies found in Asia, Africa, the Americas, and southern Europe.

species.name: Nuri bayan
species.summary: The Papuan eclectus, red-sided eclectus, or New Guinea eclectus (Eclectus polychloros) is a parrot species which is native to New Guinea. Larger than the Moluccan eclectus, the green plumage of the male only has a slight yellow tinge and the tail is tipped with a half-inch yellow band.

species.name: Tokek Rumah
species.summary: Tokek rumah atau lebih sederhana tokek adalah sejenis reptil yang masuk ke dalam golongan cecak besar, suku Gekkonidae. Tokek rumah memiliki nama ilmiah Gekko gecko (Linnaeus, 1758). Istilah tokek dalam bahasa sehari-hari biasanya mengacu kepada hewan ini.

species.name: Dara laut jambul
species.summary: Dara-laut jambul (bahasa Latin = Sterna bergii) adalah spesies burung dari famili Sternidae, dari genus Sterna.

species.name: Kehicap Ranting
species.summary: Kehicap ranting (bahasa Latin: Hypothymis azurea) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Monarchidae, dari genus Hypothymis. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan serangga keci dan memiliki habitat di hutan dataran rendah, hutan sekunder. tersebar sampai ketinggian 900 m dpl.

species.name: Kapasan Sayap-Putih
species.summary: Kapasan sayap-putih Nama Lokal : Mpepe Dlaam bahasa inggris White-shouldered Triller (bahasa latin : Lalage sueurii) adalah spesies burung yang termasuk dalam famili Campephagidae. Burung ini endemik di Indonesia, tersebar di Jawa, Bali, Nusa Tenggara, dan Sulawesi.

species.name: Walik Kembang
species.summary: Walik kembang atau dalam nama ilmiahnya Ptilinopus melanospilus adalah sejenis burung yang terdapat di dalam suku burung merpati Columbidae. Burung Walik Kembang berukuran sedang, dengan panjang mencapai 24cm. Spesies ini memiliki bulu berwarna hijau dengan paruh dan iris mata berwarna kekuningan.

species.name: Tepekong Jambul
species.summary: Tepekong jambul (bahasa Latin = Hemiprocne longipennis) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Hemiprocnidae, dari genus Hemiprocne. Burung ini memiliki habitat di hutan, hutan terbuka dengan pohon tinggi. tersebar sampai ketinggian 1.500 m dpl.

species.name: Cekakak Suci
species.summary: The sacred kingfisher (Todiramphus sanctus) is a medium-sized woodland kingfisher that occurs in mangroves, woodlands, forests, and river valleys in Australia, New Zealand, and other parts of the western Pacific. In New Zealand the species is also known by its Māori name kōtare.

species.name: Perling Ungu
species.summary: Perling ungu (Aplonis metallica) juga diketahui sebagai perling cemerlang, adalah burung pada familia jalak. Asal mereka dari Guinea Baru dan dekat pulau-pulau Australasia, dan keberadaannya jarang di wilayah timur laut Australia.

species.name: Bubut Alang-Alang
species.summary: Bubut alang-alang (bahasa Latin = Centropus bengalensis) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Cuculidae, dari genus Centropus.

species.name: Cikalang Kecil
species.summary: Cikalang kecil (Fregata ariel) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Fregatidae, dari genus Fregata. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan ikan dan bagian tubuh binatang lain, hidup atau mati yang memiliki habitat di laut, pantai.

species.name: Elanglaut perut-putih
species.summary: The white-bellied sea eagle (Icthyophaga leucogaster), also known as the white-breasted sea eagle, is a large diurnal bird of prey in the family Accipitridae.

species.name: Kuntul Karang
species.summary: Kuntul karang adalah sejenis burung dari suku Ardeidae (kerabat cangak). Merupakan burung dengan bimorfisme atau memiliki dua bentuk, yakni dengan warna yang berbeda. Dalam bahasa Inggris, burung ini disebut Pacific Reef Egret, Eastern Reef Egret atau Eastern Reef Heron.

species.name: Tiong-Lampu Biasa
species.summary: Tiong-lampu biasa atau Tengkek Buto adalah burung yang mempunyai paruh, berdarah panas, dan bereproduksi dengan cara bertelur. Ia mempunyai tompok bulat pada sayapnya. Tiong-lampu Biasa memiliki panjang 30 cm, dan dapat ditemukan di Asia Timur, dari Australia Utara hingga kepulauan Jepang.

species.name: Srigunting Jambul-Rambut
species.summary: Srigunting jambul-rambut (Dicrurus hottentottus) adalah burung Asia pada familia Dicruridae. Spesies ini dahulu dianggap sejenis dengan Dicrurus bracteatus, dengan nama "Srigunting Kelip" – yang dahulu digunakan pada kedua spesies itu – yang sekarang namanya sudah disediakan.

species.name: Kapinis Rumah
species.summary: Kapinis rumah (bahasa Latin = Apus nipalensis) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Apodidae, dari genus Apus. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan serangga kecil yang memiliki habitat di daerah terbuka, pesisir, perkotaan, tersebar sampai ketinggian 1.500 m dpl.

species.name: Sikatan Belang
species.summary: Sikatan belang (bahasa Latin: Ficedula westermanni) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Muscicapidae, dari genus Ficedula.

species.name: Cinenen Gunung
species.summary: The mountain tailorbird (Phyllergates cuculatus) is a songbird species formerly placed in the "Old World warbler" assemblage, but is now placed in the genus Phyllergates in the family Cettiidae.

species.name: Delimukan Zamrud
species.summary: Delimukan zamrud atau disebut juga burung walik adalah spesies burung yang mempunyai paruh, berdarah panas, dan membiak dengan cara bertelur. Burung ini dalam bahasa inggris disebut emerald dove karena warnanya yang hijau seperti zamrud.

species.name: Kipasan Dada-Lurik
species.summary: The northern fantail (Rhipidura rufiventris) is a species of bird in the family Rhipiduridae. It is found in Australia, Indonesia, and Papua New Guinea. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests and subtropical or tropical mangrove forests.

species.name: Gajahan penggala
species.summary: Gajahan pengala (Numenius phaeopus) adalah spesies burung perancah yang termasuk dalam famili Scolopacidae. Burung ini adalah salah satu jenis gajahan yang paling menyebar luas, berbiak di wilayah-wilayah subarktik di Amerika Utara, Asia dan Eropa.

species.name: Kirik-Kirik Australia
species.summary: Kirik-kirik australia (Merops ornatus) adalah spesies burung dalam famili Meropidae. Burung ini berbiak di Australia, pada musim dingin bermigrasi ke Pulau Irian dan Indonesia bagian timur.

species.name: Trinil Semak
species.summary: Trinil semak (bahasa Latin = Tringa glareola) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Scolopacidae, dari genus Tringa. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan cacing, larva serangga, berudu, krustasea yang memiliki habitat di pantai berlumpur, sawah, rawa air tawar. tersebar sampai ketinggian 750 m dpl.

species.name: Merpati batu
species.summary: Merpati karang (Columba livia), atau merpati batu, adalah anggota dari familia burung Columbidae. Sehari-hari burung ini lebih dikenal sebagai "merpati", walau sebenarnya burung ini memiliki banyak jenis, tercatat ada 318 jenis Columbidae yang ada di dunia, di mana sebagian besarnya adalah jenis-jenis merpati.

species.name: Elangular bido
species.summary: Elang-ular bido (Spilornis cheela) adalah sejenis elang besar yang menyebar luas di Asia, mulai dari India di barat, Nepal, Srilanka, terus ke timur hingga Cina, ke selatan melintasi Asia Tenggara, Semenanjung Malaya, kepulauan Sunda Besar, hingga ke Palawan di Filipina. Elang ini merupakan anggota suku Accipitridae.

species.name: Itik Benjut
species.summary: Itik benjut (bahasa Latin = Anas gibberifrons) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Anatidae, dari genus Anas. Itik benjut merupakan burung pemakan tumbuhan dan invertebrata yang memiliki habitat di rawa, payau, mangrove, tambak, kolam, sungai. Dapat sampai jauh ke pedalaman

species.name: Pergam Laut
species.summary: Pergam Laut atau dalam nama ilmiahnya Ducula bicolor adalah sejenis burung yang terdapat di dalam suku burung Columbidae. Burung Pergam Laut berukuran sedang, dengan panjang mencapai 38 cm. Spesies ini memiliki bulu berwarna putih dengan bulu terbang dan sebagian besar ekornya berwarna hitam.

species.name: Alap-alap sapi
species.summary: Alap-alap sapi (bahasa Latin = Falco moluccensis) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Falconidae, dari genus Falco. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan mamalia kecil, kelelawar, burung, kadal, serangga yang memiliki habitat di daerah terbuka di semua ketinggian. kebun, tegalan, tepi hutan, atau perkotaan.

species.name: Pecuk-Padi Hitam
species.summary: Pecuk-padi hitam atau pecuk hitam (Phalacrocorax sulcirostris) adalah sejenis burung air anggota suku Phalacrocoracidae. Berukuran sedang, seluruh tubuh umumnya berwarna hitam. Burung ini hidup tersebar di Australasia hingga Jawa di barat.

species.name: Kacamata Laut
species.summary: Kacamata laut (Zosterops chloris) adalah spesies burung dalam familia Zosteropidae. Ia Endemik di Indonesia, yakni di Selat Sunda hingga Kepulauan Aru.

species.name: Bondol Rawa
species.summary: The chestnut munia (Lonchura atricapilla), formerly considered as a subspecies of the tricoloured munia, is also known as black-headed munia.It is a small passerine bird.

species.name: Kicuit Batu
species.summary: Kicuit batu (Motacilla cinerea) adalah anggota kecil dari famili kicuit, Motacillidae. Spesies ini kelihatan sama dengan Kicuit kuning, tetapi ada warna kuning yang dibatasi pada tenggorokan sampai kloaka. Jantan saat perkembangbiakan memiliki tenggorokan hitam.

species.name: Cabai Panggul-Kelabu
species.summary: Cabai panggul-kelabu (Dicaeum celebicum) adalah salah satu spesies burung di dalam keluarga Dicaeidae. Burung ini endemik di Sulawesi dan Kepulauan Sula.

species.name: Pecuk-Padi Belang
species.summary: Pecuk-padi belang (Microcarbo melanoleucos), atau juga dikenal sebagai pecuk belang kecil, adalah sejenis burung laut anggota suku Phalacrocoracidae. Berwarna hitam dan putih, pecuk ini biasa ditemukan di badan-badan air di pesisir di wilayah Australasia.

species.name: Daralaut kumis
species.summary: Dara-laut kumis (Chlidonias hybrida) adalah spesies burung yang termasuk dalam famili Sternidae. Burung ini adalah burung pengunjung tetap di Sumatra, Jawa, dan Bali pada musim dingin, tetapi beberapa di antaranya juga sering terlihat pada musim panas.

species.name: Tuwur Asia
species.summary: Tuwur Asia (bahasa Latin = Eudynamis scolopacea) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Cuculidae, dari genus Eudynamis. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan buah-buahan, Ficus, serangga yang memiliki habitat di hutan sekunder, taman, kebun.

species.name: Bondol Taruk
species.summary: The black-faced munia (Lonchura molucca) is a species of estrildid finch found in Indonesia. Other common names include tricoloured munia or chestnut munia. It occurs in a wide range of habitats including artificial landscapes (e.g. parks and gardens), forest, grassland and savannah.

species.name: Sikatan Kilap
species.summary: The shining flycatcher (Myiagra alecto) is a species of bird in the family Monarchidae. It is found in northern Australia, and from the Moluccas to the Bismarck Archipelago. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests and subtropical or tropical mangrove forests.

species.name: Elang hitam
species.summary: The black eagle (Ictinaetus malaiensis) is a bird of prey. Like all eagles, it is in the family Accipitridae, and is the only member of the genus Ictinaetus. They soar over forests in the hilly regions of tropical and subtropical South and Southeast Asia, as well as southeastern China.

species.name: Sikatan Bodoh
species.summary: The snowy-browed flycatcher (Ficedula hyperythra) is a species of bird in the family Muscicapidae.

species.name: Tepekong Kumis
species.summary: The moustached treeswift (Hemiprocne mystacea) is a species of bird in the Hemiprocnidae family. It is found in the northern Moluccas, New Guinea, Bismarck and the Solomon Islands archipelagos.

species.name: Raja-Udang Meninting
species.summary: Raja-udang Meninting (Alcedo meninting) berasal dari Asia, tersebar melewati Subkontinen India dan Asia Tenggara. Persebarannya dari barat India, ke arah timur Nepal, Bhutan dan Bangladesh, menuju ke Myanmar, Thailand, Kamboja, Vietnam dan Malaysia.

species.name: Capung-Sambar Hijau
species.summary: Orthetrum sabina, the slender skimmer or green marsh hawk, is a species of dragonfly in the family Libellulidae. It is widespread, being found from south-eastern Europe and North Africa to Japan and south to Australia and Micronesia. Adults are grayish to greenish yellow with black and pale markings.

species.name: Bangkong Kolong
species.summary: Bangkong kolong atau kodok rumah memiliki nama ilmiah Bufo melanostictus Schneider. Kodok ini juga dikenal dengan beberapa nama lain seperti kodok buduk (Btw.), kodok berut/kerok, kodok kintêl (Jw.), kodok brama (Jw., yang berwarna kemerahan), dan Asian black-spined toad (Ingg.).

species.name: Cabak Maling
species.summary: Cabak maling (bahasa Latin = Caprimulgus macrurus) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Caprimulgidae, dari genus Caprimulgus.

species.name: Dara laut kecil
species.summary: Dara-laut kecil (Sternula albifrons) atau (Sterna albifrons) adalah Burung laut yang berfamilia Sternidae atau dalam Bahasa Indonesianya, Dara laut. Dari awalnya, burung ini diletakkan pada genus Sterna, di mana sekarang ini terbatas pada jenis ukuran dara-laut putih besar (Bridge et al., 2005).

species.name: Cerek Kernyut
species.summary: The Pacific golden plover (Pluvialis fulva) is a medium-sized plover. The genus name is Latin and means relating to rain, from pluvia, "rain". It was believed that golden plovers flocked when rain was imminent. The species name fulva is Latin and refers to a tawny colour.

species.name: Dara laut tengkuk-hitam
species.summary: The black-naped tern (Sterna sumatrana) is an oceanic tern mostly found in tropical and subtropical areas of the Pacific and Indian Oceans. It is rarely found inland.

species.name: Cekakak-Pita Biasa
species.summary: The common paradise kingfisher (Tanysiptera galatea), also known as the Galatea paradise kingfisher and the racquet-tailed kingfisher, is a species of bird in the family Alcedinidae. It is found in subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests of the Maluku Islands and New Guinea.

species.name: Mandar-Padi Zebra
species.summary: Mandar-padi zebra (Gallirallus torquatus) adalah spesies burung yang tergolong famili Rallidae. Burung ini tersebar di Indonesia dan Filipina.

species.name: Walik Raja
species.summary: Walik Raja (Ptilinopus superbus) adalah burung satu jenis burung dara yang tersebar di hutan Sulawesi, Papua, Australia, Philipina hingga Kepulauan Solomon.

species.name: Gagang-Bayam Timur
species.summary: Gagang-bayam timur (bahasa Latin = Himantopus leucocephalus) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Recurvirostridae, dari genus Himantopus. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan invertebrata kecil yang memiliki habitat di rawa payau, rawa tawar, danau dangkal, tepi sungai, sawah, beting lumpur, tambak garam.

The Halmahera golden bulbul (Hypsipetes chloris) is a species of passerine bird in the bulbul family of Pycnonotidae. It is found in Morotai, Halmahera and Bacan Islands, Indonesia. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests.

species.name: Dara laut biasa
species.summary: Dara-laut Biasa (Sterna hirundo) adalah burung laut dari famili Dara laut Sternidae.

species.name: Cecak tembok
species.summary: Hemidactylus platyurus, commonly known as the flat-tailed house gecko, is a species of Gekkonidae native to southeastern and southern Asia. The species is sometimes classified under the genus Cosymbotus.

species.name: Sikepmadu asia
species.summary: Sikep-madu asia (Pernis ptilorhynchus) adalah spesies burung pemangsa dalam famili Accipitridae. Burung ini tersebar di Palearktika timur, India, dan Asia Tenggara sampai Sunda Besar.

species.name: Bengkarung
species.summary: Kadal kebun alias bengkarung biasa adalah sejenis reptil berkaki empat anggota suku Scincidae (kadal sejati). Disebut kadal kebun, karena bengkarung biasa dijumpai di kebun pekarangan.

species.name: Gosong kelam
species.summary: The dusky megapode or dusky scrubfowl (Megapodius freycinet) is a medium-sized (about 41 cm long), blackish bird with a short pointed crest, bare red facial skin, dark legs, brown irises, and dark brown and yellow bill. The male and female are similar.

species.name: Kapasan Kemiri
species.summary: Kapasan kemiri (bahasa Latin: Lalage nigra) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Campephagidae, dari genus Lalage. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan serangg yang memiliki habitat di lahan pertanian, dataran rendah terbuka, hutan sekunder, hutan mangrove, tersebar sampai ketinggian 1.000 m dpl.

species.name: Gagak orru
species.summary: The Torresian crow (Corvus orru), also called the Australian crow or Papuan crow, is a passerine bird in the crow family native to the north and west of Australia and nearby islands in Indonesia and Papua New Guinea. The species has a black plumage, beak and mouth with white irises.

species.name: Raja-Udang Erasia
species.summary: Raja-udang eurasia (Alcedo atthis) juga diketahui sebagai Raja-udang biasa atau Raja-udang sungai, adalah raja-udang kecil dengan tujuh subspesies yang diakui dalam distribusi yang luas di seluruh Eurasia dan Afrika Utara.

species.name: Trinil Ekor-Kelabu
species.summary: The grey-tailed tattler or Polynesian tattler, Tringa brevipes (formerly Heteroscelus brevipes) is a small, foraging shorebird in the genus Tringa. The English name for the tattlers refers to their noisy call.

species.name: Trinil Kaki-Hijau
species.summary: Trinil kaki-hijau (bahasa Latin = Tringa nebularia) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Scolopacidae, dari genus Tringa. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan ikan, berudu, krustasea, cacing, larva serangga yang memiliki habitat di rawa, gosong lumpur, tambak.

species.name: Elang tiram
species.summary: Elang tiram atau Elang ikan, yang dalam nama ilmiahnya Pandion haliaetus adalah salah satu-satunya spesies dalam suku Pandionidae dan genus Pandion.

species.name: Angsabatu coklat
species.summary: The brown booby (Sula leucogaster) is a large seabird of the booby family, Sulidae. They present sexual dimorphism. The female booby reaches about 80 centimetres (31 in) in length, its wingspan measures up to 150 cm (4.9 ft), and they can weigh up to 1,300 g (2.9 lb).

species.name: Sikatan Matari
species.summary: Sikatan matari adalah spesies burung pengicau dalam famili Muscicapidae. Burung ini tersebar di Indonesia dan Filipina.

species.name: Ayam hutan merah
species.summary: Ayam hutan merah atau dalam nama ilmiahnya Gallus gallus adalah sejenis burung berukuran sedang, dengan panjang sekitar 78 cm, dari suku Phasianidae. Ayam betina berukuran lebih kecil, dengan panjang sekitar 46 cm.

species.name: Sikatan pulau
species.summary: Sikatan pulau (Eumyias panayensis) adalah spesies burung dari famili Muscicapidae. Burung ini tersebar di Indonesia dan Filipina.

species.name: Sikatan Burik
species.summary: The grey-streaked flycatcher or grey-spotted flycatcher (Muscicapa griseisticta) is a small passerine bird of eastern Asia belonging to the genus Muscicapa in the Old World flycatcher family Muscicapidae.

species.name: Mandar Batu
species.summary: Mandar batu (bahasa Latin = Gallinula chloropus) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Rallidae, dari genus Gallinula. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan serangga air, binatang kecil, pucuk tanaman muda yang memiliki habitat di danau, kolam, parit, sawah, tambak payau, tersebar sampai ketinggian 1.200 m dpl.

species.name: Uncal Ambon
species.summary: Uncal ambon (Macropygia amboinensis) adalah spesies burung dalam famili Columbidae.

species.name: Kepudang-Sungu Kartula
species.summary: The white-bellied cuckooshrike (Coracina papuensis) is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae. It is found in Australia, the Moluccas, New Guinea and the Solomon Islands.
The Moluccan starling (Aplonis mysolensis) is a species of starling in the family Sturnidae. It is endemic to Indonesia.
The spectacled monarch (Symposiachrus trivirgatus) is a species of bird in the family Monarchidae. It is found in Australia, Indonesia, and Papua New Guinea.

The rufous-bellied triller (Lalage aurea) is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae. It is endemic to the Maluku Islands of Indonesia. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests and subtropical or tropical mangrove forests.

species.name: Tikusan Alis-Putih
species.summary: The white-browed crake (Poliolimnas cinereus) is a species of bird in the family Rallidae. It is found in Australia, Brunei, Cambodia, Fiji, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Japan, India, Malaysia, Micronesia, New Caledonia, Palau, Papua New Guinea, the Philippines, Samoa, Singapore, Solomon Islands, Thailand, and Vanuatu.

species.name: Kedasi Laut
species.summary: The little bronze cuckoo (Chrysococcyx minutillus) is a species of cuckoo in the family Cuculidae. It is found in Southeast Asia, New Guinea and northern and eastern Australia. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests. This is the world's smallest cuckoo, at 17 grams and 15 cm (6 in).

The white-bibbed fruit dove (Ptilinopus rivoli) is a species of bird in the family Columbidae. It is found in the Maluku Islands, New Guinea and the Bismarck Archipelago. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests and subtropical or tropical moist montane forests.

species.name: Celepuk Maluku
species.summary: The Moluccan scops owl (Otus magicus) is an owl found in Indonesia (Maluku and Lesser Sunda Islands).

species.name: Cangak laut
species.summary: Cangak laut merupakan jenis burung Kuntul yang hidup di tepian pantai. Sebarannya terletak di Sumatra, Pulau Jawa, Pulau Bali, Kalimantan, sampai Australia. Burung ini berukuran besar, yakni berukuran 115 cm. Irisnya berwarna abu-abu gelap (abu-abu kecoklatan). Cangak laut beruban dan berjambul pendek.

species.name: Pergam Mata-putih
species.summary: The spectacled imperial pigeon (Ducula perspicillata) is a species of bird in the family Columbidae. It is endemic to the Maluku Islands.

species.name: Kicuit Kerbau
species.summary: The eastern yellow wagtail (Motacilla tschutschensis) is a small passerine in the wagtail family Motacillidae, which also includes the pipits and longclaws. It was often classified as a subspecies of the Western yellow wagtail.

species.name: Cekakak Pantai
species.summary: The beach kingfisher (Todiramphus saurophagus) is a species of bird in the family Alcedinidae. It is found in Indonesia, Papua New Guinea, and Solomon Islands. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical mangrove forests.
Pergam tutu (Ducula forsteni) adalah spesies burung dalam famili Columbidae. Burung ini endemik di Indonesia, penyebarannya hanya terbatas di Pulau Sulawesi dan Kepulauan Sula.

species.name: Pergam Putih
species.summary: The silver-tipped imperial pigeon (Ducula luctuosa), also known as the white-tipped imperial-pigeon, is a relatively large species of bird in the family Columbidae. It is endemic to forest, woodland and mangrove on Sulawesi and smaller nearby islands.
The Moluccan flycatcher or dark-grey flycatcher (Myiagra galeata) is a species of bird in the family Monarchidae. It is endemic to Indonesia.

Nephila pilipes (northern golden orb weaver or giant golden orb weaver) is a species of golden orb-web spider. It can be found in Japan, China, Vietnam, Cambodia, Taiwan, Malaysia, Singapore, Myanmar, Indonesia, Thailand, Laos, Philippines, Sri Lanka, India, Nepal, Papua New Guinea, and Australia.

species.name: Kipasan Sulawesi
species.summary: Kipasan sulawesi (Rhipidura teysmanni) adalah spesies burung pengicau dalam famili Rhipiduridae. Burung ini endemik Sulawesi dan Kepulauan Sula, menghuni hutan perbukitan dan hutan yang ditebang pilih.

species.name: Lakirumbai kecil
species.summary: The red-necked phalarope (Phalaropus lobatus) is a small wader. This phalarope breeds in the Arctic regions of North America and Eurasia. It is migratory, and, unusually for a wader, winters at sea on tropical oceans.

species.name: Cerek Pantai Besar
species.summary: The greater sand plover (Anarhynchus leschenaultii) is a small wader in the plover family of birds. The spelling is often given as "greater sandplover" or "greater sand-plover", but the official IOC and British Ornithologists' Union spelling is "Greater Sand Plover".

species.name: Mandar-Padi Kalung-Kuning
species.summary: The buff-banded rail (Gallirallus philippensis) is a distinctively coloured, highly dispersive, medium-sized rail of the rail family, Rallidae.

species.name: Uncal Besar
species.summary: The great cuckoo-dove (Reinwardtoena reinwardti) is a species of bird in the family Columbidae. It is found in the Maluku Islands and New Guinea.

species.name: Layang-Layang Batu
species.summary: Layang-layang batu (Hirundo javanica) atau dalam bahasa Inggris dikenal juga sebagai Pacific Swallow adalah spesies burung dalam famili Hirundinidae. Burung ini tersebar luas dari Asia Selatan hingga Asia Tenggara.

species.name: Myzomela sulawesi
species.summary: Cui-cui sulawesi (Myzomela chloroptera) adalah burung penghisap madu dalam famili Meliphagidae. Burung ini endemik di Indonesia, tersebar terbatas di Sulawesi, Taliabu, Selayar, dan Tanah Jampea.

species.name: Kepinis Laut
species.summary: Kapinis laut (bahasa Latin = Apus pacificus) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Apodidae, dari genus Apus. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan serangga kecil yang memiliki habitat di daerah terbuka, tersebar sampai ketinggian 1.500 m dpl.
The grey-headed fruit dove (Ptilinopus hyogastrus) is a species of bird in the family Columbidae. It is endemic to the northern Moluccas.

species.name: Dara laut batu
species.summary: The bridled tern (Onychoprion anaethetus) is a seabird of the family Laridae. It is a bird of the tropical oceans. The scientific name is from Ancient Greek. The genus is onux, "claw", and "prion", nail. The specific anaethetus means "senseless, stupid".

species.name: Belibis Kembang
species.summary: Belibis kembang (Dendrocygna arcuata) adalah spesies burung dalam famili Anatidae. Burung ini tersebar di Filipina, Kalimantan, Sulawesi, Jawa, Nusa Tenggara, Maluku, Papua, Australia, dan Britania Baru.

species.name: Trinil Kaki-Merah
species.summary: Trinil kaki-merah (bahasa Latin = Tringa totanus) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Scolopacidae, dari genus Tringa. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan cacing, moluska, krustasea yang memiliki habitat di beting lumpur, pantai, rawa, tambak kering, sawah dekat laut. Kadang dijumpai jauh di pedalaman.

Dicrurus bracteatus atau srigunting berkilau adalah spesies burung srigunting dari anggota famili Dicruridae dan satu-satunya spesies srigunting yang ditemukan di Australia. Burung ini mudah dikenali dari bulunya yang hitam berpadu warna-warni serta ekor bercabang yang khas.

species.name: Elangular sulawesi
species.summary: Elang-ular sulawesi (Spilornis rufipectus) adalah spesies burung pemangsa dalam famili Accipitridae. Burung ini endemik di Indonesia dan peyebarannya hanya terbatas di subkawasan Sulawesi dan Kepulauan Sula.

species.name: Elang sulawesi
species.summary: Elang sulawesi (Nisaetus lanceolatus) adalah spesies burung pemangsa dalam famili Accipitridae. Burung ini endemik di Pulau Sulawesi dan pulau-pulau satelit (Bangka (Sulawesi), Lembeh, Muna, dan Butung); Kepulauan Banggai; dan Kepulauan Sula.

species.name: Biawak Air
species.summary: Varanus salvator, atau lazim dikenal sebagai biawak air atau biawak air asia, adalah kadal besar yang endemik di Asia Selatan dan Asia Tenggara.

species.name: Sempur-Hujan Rimba
species.summary: The banded broadbill (Eurylaimus javanicus) is a species of bird in the Eurylaimidae family. It is found in Brunei, Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, Singapore, Thailand, and Vietnam. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests.

species.name: Kancilan Tuna-Warna
species.summary: The drab whistler (Pachycephala griseonota) is a species of bird in the family Pachycephalidae. It is found in the Maluku Islands. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests.

species.name: Baza pasifik
species.summary: Owaki pasifik (Aviceda subcristata) adalah spesies burung pemangsa dalam famili Accipitridae. Burung ini tersebar di Pulau Papua, Kepulauan Solomon, Australia, Maluku, Nusa Tenggara, dan kepulauan di Sulawesi Selatan.

Karakalo australia (Scythrops novaehollandiae) adalah spesies pada familia tekukur, kangkok, karakalo, dan sejenisnya, yaitu cuculidae. Ia berada dalam taksonomi monotipe pada genus scythrops. Spesies ini merupakan spesies parasitisme seinduk terbesar di dunia, dan juga tekukur terbesar.

species.name: Paok halmahera
species.summary: The ivory-breasted pitta (Pitta maxima) is a species of bird in the family Pittidae. It is endemic to North Maluku in Indonesia. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests.

species.name: Bunglon Taman
species.summary: Bunglon taman (Calotes versicolor) adalah spesies reptil dari genus Calotes dan termasuk ke dalam keluarga Agamidae.

species.name: Capung-Tengger biru
species.summary: Diplacodes trivialis, is a species of dragonfly in the family Libellulidae, known as the chalky percher or ground skimmer. It is found in China, Japan, India and southwards to New Guinea and Australia.

species.name: Cekakak Biru-Putih
species.summary: The blue-and-white kingfisher (Todiramphus diops) is a species of bird in the family Alcedinidae. It is endemic to North Maluku in Indonesia. It can be found on the islands of Morotai, Ngelengele, Halmahera, Damar, Ternate, Tidore, Moti, Bacan, Obi and Obilatu.

species.name: Taktarau Besar
species.summary: The great eared nightjar (Lyncornis macrotis) is a species of nightjar in the family Caprimulgidae. It is the largest species in the family in terms of length, which can range from 31 to 41 cm (12 to 16 in).

species.name: Pergam Boke
species.summary: The cinnamon-bellied imperial pigeon (Ducula basilica) is a species of bird in the family Columbidae. It is endemic to the northern Moluccas.

species.name: Gagak halmahera
species.summary: Gagak halmahera (Corvus validus) adalah spesies gagak yang endemik di Maluku Utara Indonesia. Di alam bebas bururung ini diketemukan di Pulau Morotai, Halmahera, Kayoa, Kasiruta, Bacan dan Obi. Burung ini dalam bahasa Inggris disebut Long billed Crow.

species.name: Cikalang besar
species.summary: Cikalang besar (Fregata minor) adalah spesies burung cikalang dalam famili Fregatidae. Burung ini tersebar di lautan tropis, tempat koloni berbiak terdekat adalah Pulau Chrismast di Samudra Hindia, Pulau Manuk, dan Gunung Api di Laut Banda.

species.name: Bubut Goliath
species.summary: The goliath coucal (Centropus goliath) is a species of cuckoo in the Cuculidae family. It is found in the northern Maluku Islands.
The Moorish idol (Zanclus cornutus), is a marine fish species, the sole extant representative of the family Zanclidae (from the Greek ζαγκίος, zagkios, "oblique") in order Perciformes.

species.name: Ikan giru Ocellaris
species.summary: Ikan giru gelang (Amphiprion ocellaris) adalah ikan aquarium populer. Ikan badut ini dapat dikenali dengan warna jingganya. Ikan ini tumbuh mencapai delapan sentimeter.

species.name: Cendrawasih gagak
species.summary: Cenderawasih gagak (Lycocorax pyrrhopterus) adalah burung Cenderawasih yang mirip gagak berukuran sedang dengan panjang sekitar 34 cm. Bulunya gelap, lembut dan seperti sutera. Paruhnya hitam, warna mata merah karmin, dan memiliki suara panggilan yang mengingatkan pada gonggongan anjing.

The Obi cicadabird (Edolisoma obiense) is a passerine bird in the family Campephagidae that is found the island of Obi in the Maluku Islands (or Moluccas) in Indonesia. The species was formerly considered to be conspecific with the common cicadabird, now renamed the Sahul cicadabird.

species.name: Walik Topi-Biru
species.summary: The blue-capped fruit dove (Ptilinopus monacha) is a species of bird in the family Columbidae. It is endemic to the northern Maluku Islands.

species.name: Daralaut sayap-putih
species.summary: Chlidonias leucopterus adalah spesies dara laut dalam keluarga Laridae. Ini adalah spesies kecil yang umumnya ditemukan di atau dekat perairan air tawar di sebagian besar dunia, termasuk Eropa, Afrika, Asia, dan Australia. Nama genus berasal dari khelidonios Yunani Kuno, "seperti menelan", dari khelidon, "menelan".

species.name: Capung-Sambar Garis-Hitam
species.summary: The scarlet skimmer or ruddy marsh skimmer, Crocothemis servilia, is a species of dragonfly of the family Libellulidae, native to east and southeast Asia and introduced to Jamaica, Florida, and Hawaii.

species.name: Kehicap Pulau
species.summary: The island monarch (Monarcha cinerascens) is a species of bird in the family Monarchidae. It is found from Sulawesi to the Solomon Islands. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests and subtropical or tropical moist montane forests.

species.name: Bidadari halmahera
species.summary: Weka-weka atau bidadari halmahera (bahasa Latin: Semioptera wallacii) adalah jenis cendrawasih berukuran sedang, sekitar 28 cm, berwarna cokelat-zaitun. Cendrawasih ini merupakan satu-satunya anggota genus Semioptera.

species.name: Cikrak Kutub
species.summary: The Arctic warbler (Phylloscopus borealis) is a widespread leaf warbler in birch or mixed birch forest near water throughout its breeding range in Fennoscandia and northern Asia. It has established a foothold in North America, breeding in Alaska.
The Moluccan brush cuckoo (Cacomantis aeruginosus), formerly known as the Moluccan cuckoo, is a species of cuckoo in the family Cuculidae. It is native to the Maluku Islands.

species.name: Kepudang-Sungu Sulawesi
species.summary: The Sulawesi cicadabird (Edolisoma morio) is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae. It is endemic to Sulawesi in Indonesia. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests and subtropical or tropical moist montane forests.
Giru ekor kuning ( Amphiprion clarkii ), juga dikenal sebagai polimas kuning, adalah ikan laut milik keluarga Pomacentridae, ikan badut dan ikan betok hias .
Kekep Sulawesi (Artamus monachus) adalah spesies burung pada familia Artamidae. Ia endemik di Indonesia.

species.name: Capung Sambar Jingga
species.summary: Orthetrum testaceum is an Asian freshwater dragonfly species. It is distributed throughout India, Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore and Thailand. One subspecies has been described, Orthetrum testaceum soembanum.

Merpati gunung papua (Gymnophaps albertisii) adalah spesies burung dalam famili merpati, Columbidae. Burung ini ditemukan di Kepulauan Bacan, Pulau Papua, Kepulauan D'Entrecasteaux, dan Kepulauan Bismarck; di sana spesies ini menghuni hutan primer, hutan pegunungan, dan dataran rendah.

species.name: Kacamata Halmahera
species.summary: The cream-throated white-eye (Zosterops atriceps) is a species of bird in the family Zosteropidae. It is endemic to the northern Moluccas.

species.name: Kowakmalam merah
species.summary: Kowak-malam merah (Nycticorax caledonicus) adalah spesies burung dalam famili Ardeidae. Burung ini berukuran sedang (50 cm) dengan leher pendek dan paruh panjang. Warna dominan merah karat pada tubuh.

species.name: Dara laut benggala
species.summary: The lesser crested tern (Thalasseus bengalensis) is a tern in the family, Laridae.

species.name: Daralaut tiram
species.summary: Dara-laut tiram (bahasa Latin = Sterna nilotica) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Sternidae, dari genus Sterna.
The white-streaked friarbird (Melitograis gilolensis) is a species of bird in the family Meliphagidae. It is monotypic within the genus Melitograis. It is endemic to the north Moluccas in Indonesia.

The Halmahera flowerpecker (Dicaeum schistaceiceps) is a species of bird in the Dicaeidae family. It is endemic to Halmahera in Indonesia. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests and subtropical or tropical moist montane forests.

species.name: Kapasan Sulawesi
species.summary: The white-rumped triller (Lalage leucopygialis) is a species of bird in the Campephagidae family. It is endemic to Sulawesi in Indonesia. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests and subtropical or tropical mangrove forests.
The black-chinned whistler (Pachycephala mentalis) is a species of bird in the family Pachycephalidae, which is endemic to Halmahera and adjacent smaller islands in North Maluku in Indonesia.

species.name: Alap-alap kawah
species.summary: Alap-alap kawah (Falco peregrinus) atau Peregrine Falcon dalam bahasa Inggris adalah salah satu spesies alap-alap berukuran besar, dengan panjang sekitar 50 cm. Burung ini memiliki bulu berwarna hitam, kelabu dan biru, berparuh kuning besar dengan ujung hitam lancip dan berekor pendek.

species.name: Cekakak Murung
species.summary: The sombre kingfisher (Todiramphus funebris) is a species of bird in the family Alcedinidae. It is endemic to island of Halmahera, in North Maluku, Indonesia.

species.name: Cekakak Merah
species.summary: Cekakak merah (Halcyon coromanda) adalah spesies burung raja-udang dalam famili Halcyonidae.

species.name: Pekaka Bua-Bua
species.summary: Pekaka bua-bua (Pelargopsis melanorhyncha) adalah spesies burung dalam famili Alcedinidae. Burung ini endemik di Indonesia, tersebar terbatas di Pulau Sulawesi (termasuk Pulau Bangka, Lembeh, Manadotua, Dodepo, Kepulauan Togian, Muna, Butung, dan Labuandata), Kepulauan Banggai (termasuk Peleng, Banggai, Lobebo, Banda),…
Cui-cui remang (Myzomela obscura) adalah spesies burung dalam famili Meliphagidae.

The moon wrasse (also known as crescent wrasse) (Thalassoma lunare) is a species of wrasse native to the Indian Ocean and the western Pacific Ocean. It is an inhabitant of coral reefs and surrounding areas at depths from 1 to 20 m (3.3 to 65.6 ft).

species.name: Kadalan Selaya
species.summary: Raffles's malkoha (Rhinortha chlorophaea) is a species of cuckoo (family Cuculidae). It was formerly often placed in Phaenicophaeus with the other malkohas, but it is a rather distinct species, with several autapomorphies and sexual dimorphism (which its presumed relatives all lack).
The Moluccan cuckooshrike (Coracina atriceps) is a species of bird in the Campephagidae family. It is endemic to Indonesia.

species.name: Kerakbasi Ramai
species.summary: The clamorous reed warbler (Acrocephalus stentoreus) is an Old World warbler in the genus Acrocephalus. It breeds from Egypt eastwards through Pakistan, Afghanistan and northernmost India to south China, southeast Asia and south to Australia. A. s. meridionalis is an endemic race in Sri Lanka.

species.name: Petrel bulwer
species.summary: Bulwer's petrel (Bulweria bulwerii) is a small petrel in the family Procellariidae, and is one of two species in the genus Bulweria (Bonaparte, 1843). This bird is named after the Scottish naturalist James Bulwer.

species.name: Trinil Rawa
species.summary: Tringa stagnatilis adalah burung perandai kecil. Ini adalah betis yang agak kecil, dan berkembang biak di padang rumput terbuka dan lahan basah taiga dari Eropa paling timur ke Timur Jauh Rusia.

species.name: Paok laus
species.summary: Paok laus (Pitta elegans) adalah spesies burung dari famili Pittidae. Habitat burung ini berada di hutan tropis atau hutan subtropis lembap yang berada di dataran rendah.

The threespot dascyllus (Dascyllus trimaculatus), also known as the domino damsel or simply domino, is a species of damselfish from the family Pomacentridae. It is native to the Indo-Pacific from the Red Sea and East Africa, to the Pitcairn Islands, southern Japan, and Australia.
Amaurornis moluccana atau kareo zaitun adalah sebuah spesies burung dalam keluarga Rallidae.
Junonia orithya adalah salah satu spesies serangga.

species.name: Kepudang Halmahera
species.summary: The dusky-brown oriole (Oriolus phaeochromus) is a species of bird in the family Oriolidae. It is endemic to North Maluku.

species.name: Angsabatu kakimerah
species.summary: The red-footed booby (Sula sula) is a large seabird of the booby family, Sulidae. As suggested by the name, adults always have red feet, but the colour of the plumage varies. They are powerful and agile fliers, but they are clumsy in takeoffs and landings.

species.name: Capung Kembara
species.summary: Pantala flavescens, the globe skimmer, globe wanderer or wandering glider, is a wide-ranging dragonfly of the family Libellulidae. This species and Pantala hymenaea, the "spot-winged glider", are the only members of the genus Pantala from the subfamily Pantalinae. It was first described by Fabricius in 1798.

The white-naped monarch (Carterornis pileatus) is a species of bird in the family Monarchidae. It is endemic to Indonesia, where it occurs in the Maluku Islands. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests.

species.name: Ibis rokoroko
species.summary: Ibis rokoroko (Plegadis falcinellus) adalah spesies burung dalam famili Threskiornithidae. Burung ini tersebar luas di dunia. Di Indonesia tercatat sebagai burung vagran di Kalimantan Selatan.

species.name: Kedidi Jari-Panjang
species.summary: The long-toed stint, Calidris subminuta, is a small wader. The genus name is from Ancient Greek kalidris or skalidris, a term used by Aristotle for some grey-coloured waterside birds. The specific subminuta is from Latin sub, "near to" and minuta, "small" from its similarity to the little stint, Calidris minuta.

The Seram golden bulbul (Hypsipetes affinis) is a species of songbird in the family Pycnonotidae. It is endemic to the Moluccas. Until recently, it was considered conspecific with the northern golden bulbul and the Buru golden bulbul. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests.

species.name: Merpati-Hutan Metalik
species.summary: Merpati-hutan Metalik adalah spesies burung yang mempunyai paruh, berdarah panas, dan membiak dengan cara bertelur.

species.name: Aoloumang
species.summary: The two-lined monocle bream (Scolopsis bilineata) is a species of threadfin bream native to the Indian Ocean and the western Pacific Ocean. An inhabitant of coral reefs, this species can be found at depths from 1 to 25 m (3.3 to 82.0 ft).

species.name: Belalang Kayu
species.summary: Valanga nigricornis, the Javanese grasshopper, is a species of grasshopper in the subfamily Cyrtacanthacridinae of the family Acrididae. It is found in southeastern Asia, the type location being Singapore. It was first described by the German zoologist Hermann Burmeister in 1838.

species.name: Capung-Jarum Centil
species.summary: Agriocnemis femina, the variable wisp or pinhead wisp, is a species of damselfly in the family Coenagrionidae. It is a small damselfly; mature males have a white pruinescence over their body, and a dark tail. It is found from India, through South-east Asia to islands in the Pacific.

species.name: Serindit maluku
species.summary: The Moluccan hanging parrot (Loriculus amabilis) is a species of parrot in the family Psittaculidae. It is endemic to forest and nearby habitats on Halmahera, Bacan and Morotai in Indonesia.

species.name: Capung-Jala Kecil
species.summary: The Red Grasshawk, also known as Common Parasol, and Grasshawk dragonfly, (Neurothemis fluctuans) is a species of dragonfly in the family Libellulidae. It is widespread in many Asian countries.
The Halmahera swiftlet (Aerodramus infuscatus) is a species of swift in the family Apodidae. It is endemic to Halmahera. It used to be considered a subspecies of the Moluccan swiftlet.

species.name: Capung-Jarum Sawah
species.summary: Ischnura senegalensis, also known variously as common bluetail, marsh bluetail, ubiquitous bluetail, African bluetail, and Senegal golden dartlet, is a widespread damselfly of the family Coenagrionidae.

species.name: Dederuk Merah
species.summary: The red turtle dove (Streptopelia tranquebarica), also known as the red collared dove, is a small pigeon which is a resident breeding bird in the tropics of Asia.

species.name: Capung-Sambar Perut-Pipih
species.summary: Potamarcha congener is a species of dragonfly in the family Libellulidae. It was first described by Jules Pierre Rambur in 1842, almost fifty years before Friedrich Karsch described its genus.
